51226429.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length LSD1 (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE) assessed as dissociation rate constant by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.3. Surface pla: Studies of binding kinetics are performed on a Biacore S200 (GE Healthcare, USA). LSD1 is aimed for an immobilization level of approximately 8000 RU with a CMS sensor chip, and the running buffer is PBS-P (0.2 M phosphate buffer 0.027 M KCl, 1.37 M NaCl, 0.5% Surfactant P20, pH 7.4). The direct binding assay is tested with buffer and sample in 2% DMSO. Then compounds with twofold dilution series are injected for 60 s and dissociated for 300 s at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The data is analyzed by Biacore S200 Evaluation Software 1.0.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. Inhibitory effect of compound 8c on LSD1 activity in vitro. (A) The reversibility of compound 8c toward LSD1 activity was determined by the dilution assay, GSK2879552 was used a control; (B) Lineweaver-Burk plots demonstrated that compound 8c was competitive with cofactor FAD; (C) SPR based sensorgram of compound 8c. Bars represent means ± SD of three independent experiments.

analyte.concentration_range: Twofold dilution series (specific range not stated)

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 0.2 M phosphate buffer, 0.027 M KCl, 1.37 M NaCl, 0.5% Surfactant P20, pH 7.4
